description:
Presenting this stunning bay-fronted Victorian townhouse located in the highly desirable area of Stanwix.

This charming property boasts four generously sized bedrooms, offering ample living space for a growing family. The ground floor features a spacious living room, sitting room, and dining room, perfect for entertaining guests or relaxing with loved ones. The modern fitted kitchen comes equipped with some integrated appliances, making meal preparation a breeze. Outside, the rear yard provides convenient vehicle access doors for off-street parking.

Situated within close proximity to a range of amenities, including a pub, school, and mini-market, this property offers a fantastic opportunity for families seeking a comfortable and convenient living space in a popular conservation area.

Don't miss out on the chance to call this wonderful property your new home!

Directions From Carlisle city centre head north over the river Eden into Stanwix. At the traffic lights by the shops turn left onto Etterby Street.

Services Mains gas, electric, water and drains are connected, but neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested.

Key Information: • Standard construction. • We understand that broadband and mobile telephone reception are available. For an indication of speeds and supply please see the OFCOM website: • There is private off road vehicle parking. • Vehicle parking is on road. (Permit required) • The property is in a conservation zone.
